summary_1line: After Bhishma’s rites, grieving Yudhishthira is consoled by Dhritarashtra and Krishna, who urge him to rule and perform sacrifices rather than sink into remorse.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira collapses weeping on the bank of the Ganga like a wounded elephant while his brothers and Krishna gather around him.
Blind Dhritarashtra, grieving for his hundred sons, raises his hands while advising the sorrowful Yudhishthira to rise and rule the earth.
Krishna stands beside the despondent king on the riverbank, calmly urging him to abandon grief and perform great sacrifices.
